input.subject: Washing machine – 8 Brackenmere Walk (ref R/022)
input.body:
Dear Ari,

Thank you for your reply about the washing machine at 8 Brackenmere Walk, Vellumford (ref R/022).

To answer your question: the landlord has told us they have ordered a new washing machine and arranged its delivery, fitting and removal of the old one. We have not been given a delivery or installation date yet.

So we can update our records correctly, could you confirm which of these applies?
- The new machine has now been delivered and fitted and is working; or
- The new machine has not arrived yet (as on our call on 24 September), and the old machine is still not working.

Once we know, we will tell you what happens next. We will follow up with you by 29 September if we have not heard from you.

Kind regards,
Northbridge Lettings

Dear Nessa,

Thank you for arranging the replacement washing machine for 8 Brackenmere Walk, Vellumford (ref R/022), and I am sorry this has taken longer than it should have. Your comments have been passed to a senior member of the team.

When we spoke to the tenant on 24 September the new machine had not yet arrived. Could you let us know the delivery and installation date (or the supplier's order reference) when you have it? The tenant works from home and has asked for at least three hours' notice before a visit, so we will pass the date on to them.

Kind regards,
Northbridge Lettings
